item.title: Rutland finance committee advances vehicle tax ordinances, recommends budget cuts for 2026
item.description: RUTLAND, Ohio — The Rutland Village Council Committee on Finance held its first hearing on three proposed ordinances that would increase the annual permissive tax for motor vehicle registrations, along with legislation adopting the village’s budget for fiscal year 2026.

item.title: Seabolt & Co. Modern Apothecary & Spa receives $10,000 Backing Small Businesses grant
item.description: POMEROY, Ohio — Seabolt & Co. Modern Apothecary & Spa has been awarded a $10,000 Backing Small Businesses Enhancement Grant from American Express and Main Street America.

item.title: Emancipation Scholarship applications now available in Gallia County
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — Gallia County Grants Administrator and Emancipation Days Committee Member Karen Sprague has confirmed that applications for the Emancipation Scholarships have been delivered to all the high schools in the county.

item.title: LaRose announces qualified candidates for May 5 Ohio primary ballot
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose announced on Thursday the list of partisan statewide candidates who met the minimum signature requirement to qualify for the May 5, 2026, primary election. Candidacies were subject to protest until Friday.

item.title: Gallia County Commission makes proclamation for National FFA Week
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The Gallia County Commission on Thursday renewed a juvenile housing contract, continued updates to airport lease agreements and approved a proclamation recognizing National FFA Week during its regular meeting.

item.title: Mason County Sheriff's Office awarded grant at County Commission meeting
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — The Mason County Commission convened for a regular meeting Thursday in Point Pleasant, where officials addressed matters impacting Mason County and welcomed visitors.

item.title: Rutland committee advances ordinance for Lynn, Weber street improvements
item.description: RUTLAND, Ohio — The Rutland Village Council Committee on Public Service held its first committee hearing on proposed legislation that, if approved, would bring improvements to two neighborhoods in the Village of Rutland.

item.title: Mayor commends Rutland Street Commissioner William Grubaugh on retirement
item.description: RUTLAND, Ohio — Mayor Tyler Eblin presented a commendation to Street Commissioner William D. Grubaugh in recognition of his service to the Village of Rutland and to congratulate him on his retirement.

item.title: Gallia County Sheriff’s Office earns statewide accreditation through Ohio Collaborative program
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The Gallia County Sheriff’s Office has officially achieved accreditation through the Ohio Collaborative Certification Program, a statewide initiative recognizing professional excellence, accountability and transparency in Ohio law enforcement agencies.
